entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: You bring the power of the storm to bear against your enemy. Striking a Thunderstricken target grants you a stack of Conductive, increasing the damage of your Storm Bolts. Striking a Shocked target will heal you. Healing over your maximum HP lingers, reducing the damage you take from the next hit or until you heal.
notes: Conductive stacks up to 50 and lasts 5 seconds.
